sentences.translation: We introduce the Japanese hot spring culture.
Hot springs are natural hot springs that are warmed by geothermal water.
Because Japan has many volcanoes, there are more than 3,000 hot springs throughout the country.
The difference between hot springs and public baths:
The hot spring uses natural hot water.
The public bathhouse is a public bathhouse where tap water is boiled.
Both are places where you can enter naked relationships.
The manners of hot springs are important.
First, wash your body well before entering.
Don't put your towel in the bathtub.
Place it on your head or in the washroom.
Those with tattoos (tattoos) may be refused bathing in many hot springs.
Types of hot springs:
The outdoor bath is an outdoor bath, where you can enjoy the natural scenery.
The inner bath (uchiburo) is an indoor bath.
Mixed bathing (comfort) is a bath that can be used by men and women together, and it is less.
There is a culture called "Toji".
It is to stay in the hot springs for a long time and to treat the disease.
It is said that certain springs are effective for skin diseases and neuralgia.
After the hot spring, it is standard to wear Yukata (Yukata) and relax.
Please enjoy your trip to Japan along with your meal at the Onsen Ryokan.
